title: Embedding Democratic Values into Social Media AIs via Societal Objective Functions
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It focuses on measuring political constructs like partisan animosity and anti-democratic attitudes in social media posts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a focus of the study. The research centers on political attitudes and democratic values. Incidental mentions of a religious group (Jews) and a place of worship (synagogue) appear in example social media posts used as stimuli.
